method: Interactive in-app browser walkthrough of production QuickQuery mounted in the accompanying local harness
checks: Entering ID and tabbing into untouched NAME leaves the validation panel hidden.
Tabbing away from empty NAME shows B1: NAME is required.
Clicking a validation issue selects the indicated cell.
Correcting NAME clears its error; committing AGE=abc reports invalid numeric input.
Correcting AGE to 42 clears its error; adding a blank row adds no error.
Entering row 2 ID=2 leaves untouched NAME quiet; clicking another row reports B2: NAME is required.
Switching to another valid tab shows no inherited errors; switching back restores the row 2 error.
Pasting only ID=3 into row 3 reports the missing NAME immediately.
Generate with a missing NAME produces no SQL; correcting the name allows generation with all three rows.
limitations: Isolated component, not signed-in application shell. Legacy input-validation-browser.mjs expectations updated but that standalone script was not executed in this run.
